nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riot, the single woman defined by <Picture 1> and continued from <Video 1>. Preserve her facial identity, light eyes, short disordered copper-red hair, lean athletic proportions, black cropped leather jacket, black shirt, rain-wet condition, and controlled alert physicality.

<Subject 2> is the single Quorum manifestation defined by <Picture 2> and continued from its appearance in <Video 1>. It is an uncannily tall elongated feline-hominid figure wearing layered black ceremonial robes, a deep patterned hood, dark metallic collars, chains, and circular pendants. Its feline face remains recessed in the hood.

<Subject 3> is the stormbound Highland Orrery installation established by <Picture 3> and <Video 1>, including the wet black-stone platform, monumental dark pillars, partial brass Orrery structure, rain, wind, low cloud ceiling, and cold desaturated natural light.

<Video 1> is the immediate visual and temporal continuity source. It provides the final over-the-shoulder relationship between Riot and the Quorum, their positions, screen direction, current weather, lighting, and physical state.

<Audio 1> is the two-performer voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S2). Use both recorded human voices as components of one unified Quorum vocal identity, combining their timbral qualities into a closely synchronized collective presence rather than presenting them as two alternating speakers.

<Audio 2> is the synchronized environmental audio from <Video 1>, referenced for continuity of Highland rain, wind, distant thunder, Orrery movement, and the acoustic character of the open stone enclosure.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation + audio reference] The target video continues directly from <Video 1> through three concise cinematic shots. Riot recognizes the Quorum and quietly says, “You.” A closer portrait reveals the Quorum’s hooded feline face as it makes one minimal head movement and briefly flashes green nocturnal eyeshine from passing storm light. The clip ends from behind the Quorum, with Riot recovering her composure.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - preserve Riot’s established identity, damp hair, black clothing, wet skin, guarded posture, and eyeline toward the Quorum.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - preserve one continuous Quorum figure with its hood, elongated anatomy, feline facial structure, black robes, necklaces, pendants, and restrained stillness.

<Subject 3> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - preserve the wet Highland installation, monumental stone scale, storm lighting, rain, and partial Orrery elements.

<Video 1> (continuity, screen direction, character positions, and scene state): fully_preserved - begin immediately after its final image while changing camera position through a motivated hard cut. Continue the established rain, wind, storm, and mechanical acoustic texture without directly copying the original signal.

<Audio 1>: reference - use both source voices to guide the Quorum’s fused vocal timbre and brief wordless resonance without copying the source recording.

detailed_description:
The target video uses restrained photorealistic science-fiction cinematography, compressed telephoto perspective, realistic wet skin and fabric, controlled micro-performance, and precise synchronized stereo audio. Generate a 7-second clip.

[Shot 1] Continue immediately after <Video 1> with a clean hard cut to an 85mm close-up of <Subject 1> (S1). Frame Riot in a tight right-facing three-quarter profile, with her wet face filling most of the image and the dark storm environment softly defocused behind her. Her eyes remain fixed on the Quorum. Surprise registers as a brief arrested breath and slight widening of the eyes, then compresses into defensive control.

At approximately 00:00.410, <Subject 1> (S1) says quietly, <d>[English] You.</d> Her voice is a low female mezzo-soprano approaching contralto, chest-resonant and lightly rough, with clear natural consonants, neutral American English, restrained volume, and dry irritation. Here the delivery carries stunned recognition beneath immediate self-command. Her lips close after the single word and her gaze remains steady.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.650, cut to a locked 100mm medium close-up of <Subject 2> from a slight left-facing three-quarter angle. Frame the Quorum from the upper chest upward. The deep hood forms a dark architectural shape around the recessed feline face. Fine rain crosses the foreground. Damp patterned fabric, metal collars, chains, and one circular pendant catch restrained storm highlights.

The Quorum inclines its head approximately four degrees toward Riot in one slow, precise movement. Its shoulders and torso remain still.

At approximately 00:03.000, a brief lateral pulse of cold storm wind crosses the hood.

Synchronize the wind with one soft low-frequency thunder pulse and one tiny bright pendant-chain tick. Beneath the thunder, <Subject 2> (S2) produces a very brief wordless breath resonance guided by <Audio 1>: both source timbres fuse in close unison into one quiet, non-localized collective vocal texture. The sound lasts less than half a second and contains no spoken word. The Quorum’s mouth remains still.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.650, cut to a 70mm over-the-shoulder reverse shot from immediately behind the Quorum’s left shoulder. Its dark hood and robe form the soft right foreground. <Subject 1> stands in medium close-up beyond it, facing camera-left toward the Quorum. A partial brass Orrery ring crosses the middle distance.

Riot holds its gaze. Her breathing resumes. Her expression changes from startled recognition to focused interrogation: brow slightly lowered, jaw set, shoulders steady. She draws one quiet preparatory breath.

Across all three shots, the storm ceiling darkens subtly and the upper clouds continue their slow lateral reorganization. End on Riot maintaining eye contact.

overall_soundscape:
Reference <Audio 2> for continuous wind, rain on leather and stone, low valley storm pressure, and restrained Orrery mechanics. Riot’s spoken word remains physically localized within the stone enclosure with short natural reflections. The eyeshine event receives one synchronized low thunder pulse, one precise high metallic chain tick, and one extremely brief non-localized dual-timbre breath resonance guided by <Audio 1>. After the accent, rain and wind return to their established levels. Preserve clear dynamic separation and intelligibility.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
